rationale: The agent did not follow key policy requirements. Although tool entries suggest the agent looked up the user and orders, it made order-changing writes (two modify_pending_order_items calls) without first confirming with the user. The final message announces that both pending t-shirt orders were already updated and charges applied, violating the requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. The agent also failed to answer the user’s first request about how many t-shirt options are available. Additionally, the message includes specifics about card type/last four and price differences not supported by any shown tool results, risking fabrication. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy.
